Subject: The Ridgeline 2P is available again
Preview: 2.1 kg, 3-season, ripstop nylon — ready when your next trip is.
Body: Your next trip deserves a shelter that doesn't slow you down.

The Northbay Ridgeline 2P Tent (NB-TNT-02) is available again. It's a 3-season tent built for two, weighing in at 2.1 kg — light enough to carry without negotiating with your pack, sturdy enough for spring shoulder-season and summer alpine conditions.

The ripstop nylon construction holds up to regular trail use. Two people fit comfortably. It packs down small.

A note on limits: the Ridgeline is rated for 3 seasons. It's not engineered for winter conditions or sustained heavy snow load — plan accordingly.

If it was on your list before it sold out, now's the time to check availability.
